fieldValues.title: Finished work waits for the owner's merge
fieldValues.statement: Agents finish work in hours, but almost every pull request waits for me to merge it on GitHub, away from the place where I affirm, answer or ratify. My acts there do not finish anything, so the work I judged still waits, and I am drawn to GitHub to clear it.
source_ref: Work-flow audit 2026-10-23 (source-documents/work-flow-audit-2026-10-23): 254 merged PRs in the week, every one through the owner
